name: mint_pod_from_path
description:
Mint a pod from a file on disk and return its pod_id. Auto-indexes: hashes the bytes, copies into content-addressed storage (data/pods/ or data/images/), dedupes against existing pods (same bytes → same pod_id), and tags by kind (image/video/audio/document/file) so pod_search can filter.

Use when you need to attach a local file to an outbound action — most commonly: pick file with `run_shell ls`, mint with this tool, pass the returned pod_id to `send_email` as `pod_ids: [...]`.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Absolute filesystem path to the file. Tilde paths (~/Pictures/foo.jpg) are accepted.

outputs.description: Human-readable confirmation with the pod_id and kind.
{pod_id, kind, mime_type, sha256, stored_path, file_size_bytes, deduped: bool}.

arguments_prompt:
Mint a pod from a file on disk so it can be attached to outbound actions.

Field:
  - `path` — absolute path to the file. `~/Pictures/foo.jpg` is fine.

Returns `pod_id` you can pass to `send_email` as `pod_ids: [...]`.

Example:
  `{ "path": "~/Pictures/IMG_1234.jpg" }`
